_read_by: services/shared/tts-spend-guard.cjs (jobs #425, #430). Characters, not dollars. The committed BASELINE is DEFAULT_BUDGETS in that file; this file may LOWER any limit freely. Anything looser (a higher cap/pool/share/alert line/repeat limit, a shorter repeat window, a different cycleStartDay) counts only inside a raise block: { "raise": { "<field>": <value>, "by": "<who>", "why": "<reason>", "until": "<ISO date, at most 31 days out>" } } on that provider (or on repeat / divergence). An unsigned, expired or too-long raise is IGNORED and alerted. Every change in the limits in force is alerted and logged in the DB (tts_spend_limit_log). A TTS_SPEND_BUDGETS override file counts only with a top-level signed { by, why, until }.

hold.message: Tom ruled 2026-09-28: the TTS daily limit is 100,000 characters in total across all providers (Cartesia + Azure + the rest), and no big audio jobs. Going above it needs TOM'S EXPLICIT GO for that job - then a signed raise { dailyCapChars, by, why, until } on the provider and a raised combinedDailyCapChars here. Do not split the job to fit under the cap.

raise.why: Tom 2026-09-28 14:50Z: allow Cartesia from now on with the new controls in place; we cannot stop generating audio for a month. Daily cap 1M and daily alert 300k unchanged.
